title: Tests: provenance routing — group log presence by source
description:
Test suite verifying the group log branching logic with all four injection sources.

What: crates/reader/tests/injection_provenance_tests.rs

Oracle: directly query group_log and article_numbers SQLite tables after ingest; expected presence/absence derived from the is_peerable() spec, not from the code under test.

Tests:
1. nntp_post_writes_group_log: inject article with NntpPost source; assert group log has one entry for this article CID.
2. smtp_newsgroups_writes_group_log: SmtpNewsgroups source; assert group log entry present.
3. smtp_sieve_writes_group_log: SmtpSieve source; assert group log entry present.
4. smtp_listid_no_group_log: SmtpListId source; assert group log has zero entries for this CID.
5. smtp_listid_readable_via_nntp: SmtpListId source; assert article appears in article_numbers and overview (reader can serve it).
6. mixed_batch: inject one SmtpListId and one NntpPost; assert exactly one group log entry (the NntpPost); both appear in article_numbers.
7. old_queue_file_defaults_to_sieve: deserialize NntpQueue envelope JSON with no injection_source field; assert it defaults to SmtpSieve and writes group log entry.
